title: Arc's Dutiful Armor
description: My Dutiful Armor, I forged armor for warriors long ago, I made tools for their wants, and weapons for their power. Allow me to show you the way of attaining such tools and armor.
body:
This Project adds:
3 Unique Materials and Armors (Heavy Iron, Blue Silver/Crescent Alloy & Platinum Sun Gem)
it also adds tools for Blue Silver & Platinum Sun which offer two distinct ways of using tools, either as weapons or as... tools.

This project also adds in a Mob called **Wandering Knight**, which is a tough humanoid opponent that attacks on sight and spawns at night and in dark areas sometimes, it is best to be atleast have iron gear before fighting them fully.

**This Project is far from finished** and you must understand it is a **Work In Progress**, the balancing is also very off, all the unique materials, items and armors are very strong and will make the game easier once attaining them. I plan to add in additional resources to be attained before you can craft such dutiful armor.

-----------------------------------------------------------------
To be added:
- ~~Excalibar Material + Armor & Tools~~
- Doing light patches for armor (tweaking how they work on the body)
- Adding in three unique weapons for each material (aside from Heavy Iron)
- Making three tiers of Armor. Light, Medium, & Heavy for each Unique Material.
- Giving Armors Special Affects (Such as ~~Fire Resistance, Speed~~, Strength, Absorption, Etc.)
- Recreating the Sprites for Armors and Tools
- Making Unique Block and Ore Variants of Blocks.
